name: Nettle Guard
description: Valiant -- Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, it gets +0/+2 until end of turn. {1}, Sacrifice this creature: Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
notes: First attempt found a real, previously-missed bug: Cost$ 1 Sac<1/CARDNAME> combines mana AND sacrifice, but the sac-cost detection only matched when Sac<> was the ENTIRE cost string (anchored at start) -- a mixed cost like this matched nothing, so the whole {1}-sacrifice-destroy ability had no cost node and no effect chain at all. Fixed with a bracket-aware Sac<...> extraction (not a naive space-split, since Namazu Trader's own Sac<> description clause contains spaces internally -- caught and fixed a real regression from the first fix attempt) plus a coarseType('CARDNAME') -> 'self' fix (was rendering as the literal, meaningless thing:"cardname"). Verified: node E now shows the sac-cost move (cost:{1}, bf->gy, self) chained into F (Destroy target artifact/enchantment) -- a real, systemic fix affecting every mixed mana+sac cost, not just this card. Same open ValidSource$YouCtrl gap as Flowerfoot Swordmaster/Mouse Trapper remains on the first ability, so not a full match.
